# docker.network creates networks, docker.container joins one, and
# docker.network_attach connects a container to another under aliases that
# other containers there resolve. A second run does nothing, a disconnected
# container or a removed network is restored, changed aliases reconnect, and
# --clean removes everything.
[!docker] skip
[!exec:go] skip

# HOME is empty, so the docker CLI finds no user-installed buildx plugin.
exec sh -c 'p=$(command -v docker-buildx) || exit 0; mkdir -p "$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins" && ln -s "$p" "$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-buildx"'

bit
stdout 'net ▶ docker network create bit-test-net-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
stdout 'side ▶ docker network create --driver bridge bit-test-side-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
stdout 'app ▶ docker run .*--network bit-test-net-[0-9a-f]{12} '
stdout 'attach ▶ docker network connect --alias web --gw-priority 2 bit-test-side-[0-9a-f]{12} bit-test-app-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
stdout 'probe ✔ ok'
stdout 'ip ✔ ok'
bit names
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker inspect --format "{{range \$n, \$_ := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{\$n}} {{end}}" "$app"'
stdout 'bit-test-net-[0-9a-f]{12} '
stdout 'bit-test-side-[0-9a-f]{12} '
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker inspect --format "{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks \"$side\").IPAddress}}" "$app"'
cmp stdout ip.txt
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker inspect --format "{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks \"$side\").Aliases}}" "$app"'
stdout '\bweb\b'
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker inspect --format "{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks \"$side\").GwPriority}}" "$app"'
stdout '\A2\n\z'

bit
! stdout '✔ ok'
stdout 'attach · no changes'

# A container disconnected out of band is connected again.
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker network disconnect "$side" "$app"'
bit
stdout 'attach ▶ .*\(endpoint missing\)'
stdout 'attach ✔ ok'
! stdout 'app ✔'
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker inspect --format "{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks \"$side\").Aliases}}" "$app"'
stdout '\bweb\b'

# A network removed out of band is created again, the container connected
# and the probe started on it.
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker rm -f "$probe" >/dev/null && docker network disconnect "$side" "$app" && docker network rm "$side" >/dev/null'
bit
stdout 'side ▶ .*\(network missing\)'
stdout 'side ✔ ok'
stdout 'attach ✔ ok'
stdout 'probe ✔ ok'
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker network inspect --format "{{range .Containers}}{{.Name}}{{end}}" "$side"'
stdout 'bit-test-app-[0-9a-f]{12}'

# Changed aliases reconnect the container, and a probe resolves the new one.
cp BUILD.bit.www BUILD.bit
bit
stdout 'attach ▶ docker network connect --alias web --alias www '
stdout 'attach ✔ ok'
stdout 'probe ✔ ok'
exec sh -c '. ./names.sh && docker inspect --format "{{(index .NetworkSettings.Networks \"$side\").Aliases}}" "$app"'
stdout '\bwww\b'

cp names.sh saved.sh
bit --clean
stdout 'attach ▶ docker network disconnect bit-test-side-[0-9a-f]{12} bit-test-app-[0-9a-f]{12}'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker container inspect "$app"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker container inspect "$probe"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker network inspect "$net"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker network inspect "$side"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker image inspect "$app:v1"'
! exec sh -c '. ./saved.sh && docker images -q --filter "label=id=${app##*-}" | grep .'

-- BUILD.bit --
let id   = replace(sha256(project_dir()), "^(.{12}).*$", "$1")
let arch = replace(replace(trim(exec("docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}'")), "^aarch64$", "arm64"), "^x86_64$", "amd64")

server = go.exe {
  package = "."
  output  = "server"
  cgo     = false
  goos    = "linux"
  goarch  = arch
}

image = docker.image {
  tag        = "bit-test-app-#{id}:v1"
  build_args = { ID = id }
  depends_on = [server]
}

net = docker.network {
  name = "bit-test-net-#{id}"
}

side = docker.network {
  name   = "bit-test-side-#{id}"
  driver = "bridge"
}

app = docker.container {
  image   = image.ref
  name    = "bit-test-app-#{id}"
  network = net.name
}

attach = docker.network_attach {
  network     = side.name
  container   = app.name
  aliases     = ["web"]
  gw_priority = 2
}

# Healthy only once it reaches the app by its alias on the side network.
probe = docker.container {
  image       = image.ref
  name        = "bit-test-probe-#{id}"
  network     = side.name
  healthcheck = { test = "check http://web:8080/", interval = 200ms }
  depends_on  = [attach]
}

ip = exec {
  command = "printf '%s\n' #{attach.ip_address} > ip.txt"
  outputs = "ip.txt"
  inputs  = []
}

explicit names = exec {
  command = "printf 'app=%s\nprobe=%s\nnet=%s\nside=%s\n' bit-test-app-#{id} bit-test-probe-#{id} bit-test-net-#{id} bit-test-side-#{id} > names.sh"
  outputs = "names.sh"
  inputs  = []
}
-- BUILD.bit.www --
let id   = replace(sha256(project_dir()), "^(.{12}).*$", "$1")
let arch = replace(replace(trim(exec("docker info --format '{{.Architecture}}'")), "^aarch64$", "arm64"), "^x86_64$", "amd64")

server = go.exe {
  package = "."
  output  = "server"
  cgo     = false
  goos    = "linux"
  goarch  = arch
}

image = docker.image {
  tag        = "bit-test-app-#{id}:v1"
  build_args = { ID = id }
  depends_on = [server]
}

net = docker.network {
  name = "bit-test-net-#{id}"
}

side = docker.network {
  name   = "bit-test-side-#{id}"
  driver = "bridge"
}

app = docker.container {
  image   = image.ref
  name    = "bit-test-app-#{id}"
  network = net.name
}

attach = docker.network_attach {
  network     = side.name
  container   = app.name
  aliases     = ["www", "web"]
  gw_priority = 2
}

# Healthy only once it reaches the app by its alias on the side network.
probe = docker.container {
  image       = image.ref
  name        = "bit-test-probe-#{id}"
  network     = side.name
  healthcheck = { test = "check http://www:8080/", interval = 200ms }
  depends_on  = [attach]
}

ip = exec {
  command = "printf '%s\n' #{attach.ip_address} > ip.txt"
  outputs = "ip.txt"
  inputs  = []
}

explicit names = exec {
  command = "printf 'app=%s\nprobe=%s\nnet=%s\nside=%s\n' bit-test-app-#{id} bit-test-probe-#{id} bit-test-net-#{id} bit-test-side-#{id} > names.sh"
  outputs = "names.sh"
  inputs  = []
}
-- Dockerfile --
FROM scratch
# A label unique to the project gives its image an ID no other run shares.
ARG ID
LABEL id=$ID
COPY server /server
# Docker runs a healthcheck with /bin/sh -c, and scratch has no shell.
COPY server /bin/sh
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]
-- go.mod --
module example.com/server

go 1.22
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	// As /bin/sh -c, run a healthcheck: "check [url]" fetches the URL, by
	// default this server's.
	if filepath.Base(os.Args[0]) == "sh" {
		words := strings.Fields(os.Args[len(os.Args)-1])
		url := "http://127.0.0.1:8080/"
		if len(words) > 1 {
			url = words[1]
		}
		if len(words) > 0 && words[0] == "check" {
			if resp, err := http.Get(url); err == nil && resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
				os.Exit(0)
			}
		}
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	http.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		fmt.Fprintln(w, "ok")
	})
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":8080", nil); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
